name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　ギロロ伍長
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Corporal Giroro

ja: 話題のＴＶアニメ「ケロロ軍曹」に登場するギロロ伍長のプラモデルです。
手と足のパーツが複数付属し差替えで様々なパーツを再現可能です。
目は回転式で表情が変化し、劇中で携帯したオプションパーツも多数付属しています。
en: A plastic model of Corporal Giroro that appears in the popular TV anime "Keroro Sergeant".
Multiple hand and foot parts are included, and various parts can be reproduced by replacing them.
The eyes are rotatable and their expressions change, and many of the optional parts that were carried in the play are also included.
